text:
Maya: Quick experiment idea — seed small free-credit bundles in the first-run UX modal for inbound users who click through from webinar/launch posts. include 3 curated prompt templates and a CTA "Try with your data". track `credit_assigned`, `prompt_used`, `first_generation`. utm tag = utm_source=launch-ui
Sam: Love that. What’s the primary success metric? activation vs retention?
Maya: Primary = activation rate (>=3 generations within 7 days). Secondary = conversion to paid within 30 days. target lift: 8–12% vs baseline.
Jon: Two quick variants to A/B:
- Variant A: 50 credits + 3 starter prompt templates inline
- Variant B: 30 credits + single example template + webinar invite link
Also split by source (community / organic / paid) so we can see attribution.
Ellie: Ops Q: how do we mint credits? need expiry policy and quotas. Recommend expiry = 30 days and per-account cap. Also add soft reminder email at day 7.
Maya: Copy draft for modal (quick):
```
Headline: Try Redwood with 50 free tokens
Body: We seeded credits so you can test real prompts on your data. Includes 3 starter templates to get results fast.
CTA: Try with your data →
```
Jon: I'll adapt tone for launch post variants and landing. Will also produce a short GIF walkthrough for the modal.
Ava: I'll wire tracking: GA + Segment + product_events. Setting feature flag in LaunchDarkly: `seeding_modal_nov24` and will tag events: `credit_assigned`, `prompt_edited`, `generation`, `first_payment`. sending payload example: `{ event: 'credit_assigned', user_id, amount: 50, source: 'launch-ui' }`.
launch-bot: Campaign schedule created: seeding_modal_nov24 -> rollout at 2024-11-24T09:00:00Z (canary 10%).
Sam: Ops checklist: update billing/quota docs, make sure we have a clean flow for users who hit the free-credit cap, and add a retention dashboard. Also set up experiment size calc — we need ~2k users per arm to detect ~8% lift with 80% power.
Ava: Confirmed — I'll create the cohort in Looker and a dashboard for `activation_rate` by variant. I'll also add an event property `variant: A|B`. :white_check_mark:
Ellie: Small infra note: token generator rate-limit should be checked for burst of signups. I'll coordinate with eng-sre. Also confirm email cadence for day7 reminder.
Maya: Timeline proposal: copy by Tue, design + GIF by Wed, engineering + tracking by Thu, soft launch Fri (canary), full rollout Mon.
Jon: I'll also prepare a micro-webinar follow-up email to convert seeded users: subject suggestion: "Quick wins with Redwood — 20 minutes to better latency & cost". will include 2 x benchmarks and 1 customer quote.
Sam: Great. Owning end-to-end: we'll validate activation lift at day 7 and revenue conversion at day 30. If positive, plan to scale credit amount & add onboarding flow to dedicated customers.
Maya: Thanks team — can we sync 11/22 10:00am PT to finalize copy/variants? I'll send calendar.
Ava: Added tasks in Asana and assigned instrumentation to myself.
Ellie: I'll run a quick ops runbook and post in #eng-oncall for the Friday rollout window. :thumbsup:
Jon: Creative draft by EOD tomorrow.
Maya: Perfect — let's keep thread updates short. cheers! :sparkles:
